channel.title: GeoPulse. Geopolitics in brief
channel.description: Signal-first briefings on geopolitics, edited by Lavkesh Dwivedi.

item.title: Born with hearing loss, she found her voice on the musical theatre stage
item.description: Growing up with hearing loss left Sabrina Wong shy and unsure of herself. Music, theatre and speech therapy gave the 21-year-old LASALLE College of the Arts graduate the confidence to pursue a dream she never thought possible. Born with hearing loss, she found her voice on the musical theatre stage.

item.title: Trump Says Iran 'Far More Serious' In Talks, Even As Attacks Intensify, Widen In Region
item.description: US President Donald ⁠Trump ⁠said Washington and Tehran were still conducting negotiations to end their conflict -- even as attacks intensified throughout the region, further threatening to widen the conflict into a full-blown Middle East war. Trump Says Iran 'Far More Serious' In Talks, Even As Attacks Intensify, Widen In Region.

item.title: Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests
item.description: Sixteen people are facing charges connected to protests in Isfahan in January, during which a colonel in Iran's Revolutionary Guard was killed. Rights defenders are raising concerns about the legitimacy of the case, including the charges against 20-year-old sisters Taraneh and Romina Rahimi. Iranian Sisters, Aged 20, Tried In High-Profile Case Tied To January Protests.

item.title: Indian seafarer killed in attack on ship in Black Sea
item.description: The External Affairs Ministry said MV Omorfi was attacked while transiting the Black Sea, reportedly in Russian territorial waters; at the time of the incident, there were 10 crew members on board, including three Indians Indian seafarer killed in attack on ship in Black Sea.

item.title: Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says
item.description: Russia's deepening partnerships with China, Iran, and North Korea represent one of the most significant geopolitical realignments driven by the war in Ukraine. Yet according to Andrea Kendall-Taylor, viewing this grouping through the lens of a traditional military alliance misses the bigger picture. Russia's 'Axis Of Upheaval' Is Built To Last Beyond Ukraine, Analyst Kendall-Taylor Says.

item.title: Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank
item.description: Two other Israelis and four more Palestinians were wounded, health officials said, and the Israeli military announced it was preparing for an “extensive” counterterror operation in the West Bank, with troops surrounding the town of Nablus Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank.

item.title: ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread
item.description: The bank set the ​coupon at 100 basis points over U. S. Treasuries, sharply ⁠lower the initial guidance of 130 basis points, for its first dollar debt sale in nearly nine years. The coupon works out to be ‌5.46%. ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread.

item.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
item.description: Guyanese authorities confirm 72 deaths after a state ferry capsized off the coast, leaving 179 people aboard. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodiesThe confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued.

item.description: Earlier this month, the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was buried in his hometown of Mashhad after a four-day ceremony. Many international delegations were present, but each country will have chosen their representatives with the utmost care. Sending high-ranking officials would go beyond mere diplomatic courtesy, and possibly signal an alliance. item.title: ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes
item.description: One month after twin earthquakes rocked Venezuela, thousands of women and girls continue to face difficulty in accessing essential healthcare and protection services, a senior official with the UN reproductive and sexual health agency UNFPA said on Friday. ‘Women do not stop giving birth in an emergency’ – one month after Venezuela quakes.

item.title: After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door
item.description: A new mobile UN peacekeeping base in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has allowed local authorities to continue responding to the fast-moving Ebola outbreak there after violence disrupted the work of medics at a treatment centre set up to contain the spread. After an Ebola centre was attacked, peacekeepers moved in next door.

item.title: In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water
item.description: In El Obeid, women and girls now face an impossible choice over something as basic as a bucket of water: risk a drone strike by collecting it in daylight, or risk rape by waiting until dark. In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water.

item.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local
item.description: Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon ForestIndigenous leaders on the Brazil-Peru border say their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying Amazon Forest, building roads and trafficking drugs. item.title: Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea
item.description: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics hubs near St. Petersburg and in occupied Crimea, causing fires and disruptions. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine also hit a key military facility in Russia’s Kirov region that supplies components for aircraft and missile systems. Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea.

item.title: Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes
item.description: Ukraine struck targets in several parts of Russia early on July 24, including another warehouse of Russian e-commerce retailer Wildberries, as Kyiv continues to expand its retaliatory long-range strike campaign in an effort to force Moscow into negotiations. Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes.

item.title: Iranians find community in art, culture and memes as missiles fly
item.description: Coverage of the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States has largely focused on battlefield developments, political statements and international diplomacy. However, another story has been unfolding on the streets of Iran. Despite fears of further military escalation dominating daily life, residents continue to take up space, both in person and online. item.title: Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea
item.description: Islamabad has condemned attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi-flagged vessels in the Red Sea. It also warned that any aggressive actions toward Pakistan-flagged vessels or the country's maritime interests would be regarded as a “grave threat” that may result in “lawful use of force.” Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea. Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea.

item.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
item.description: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify. On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk.

item.title: Iran urged to stop protest-related executions
item.description: Independent UN human rights investigators on Thursday called for Iran to immediately halt the execution of 10 men who took part in a protest in the central city of Isfahan earlier this year, warning that some of their relatives have already been called for final visits. Iran urged to stop protest-related executions.

item.title: Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns
item.description: Food security and child nutrition have improved across the Gaza Strip largely due to a scale-up in humanitarian assistance and commercial traffic, but progress remains fragile and could quickly reverse without sustained access, funding and recovery support. Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns.
